short: Sum the losses for one word

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.SizeData₂.Ee
lean.plain: Sum the losses for one word
lean.note: $\mathrm{Ee}(u)$ collects the word-dependent corrections and is subtracted in the lower bound for $\mu(N_u)$. The dimension count for $T(u)$ gives another occurrence of its leading term, which can then be cancelled.
